api.tooManyTries: too many attempts: try again in {seconds} s
api.lastUser: at least one account must remain
api.noTokenKey: Kyber has no key for Admin’s tokens. Reinstall KyberNow Station to create it.
api.accessPending: This device just received its access: the server must restart to take it into account. It will do so as soon as {who} ends; try again then.
api.pairTooMany: too many pairing requests: try again in a minute
api.requestGone: this request has expired: the device will send a new one with another code
api.unknownRoute: route unknown to this version of Admin

auth.adminPasswordLength: the administrator password must be at least 10 characters long

pairing.deviceIdentity: the device must give its identifier and name

config.passwordLength: the password must be at least 8 characters long
config.badUsername: the username cannot contain “:” or control characters

display.refreshRange: refresh rate out of range (24 to 500 Hz)

update.sessionConflict: A device is connected: installing will end its session
update.sessionConflictNamed: A device is connected ({name}): installing will end its session
update.rolledBack: The previous version ({version}) has been put back.
update.undoFailed: Going back to the previous version failed: version {version} may be half replaced. Check the kyber, admin and tray folders (and their .prev) in {dir}, or reinstall with KyberNow-Station-Setup.exe.
update.noOutput: no output: the updater stopped before writing anything
update.alreadyInstalling: an installation is already in progress
update.noKnownVersion: no known version: check for updates first
update.noSignedPackage: version {version} has no signed update package
update.noPrevious: no previous version on this computer
update.unsigned: version {version} is not signed (no {file}): it cannot be installed from Admin
update.noRelease: no version published on the {channel} channel

station.windowsOnly: restarting the Station only works on Windows
station.restartConflict: A device is connected ({name}): restarting will end its session
station.tooSoon: the Station has just restarted: try again in {seconds} s
station.upToDate: KyberNow Station {version} is up to date: nothing to install
station.requiresSetup: KyberNow Station {version} installs with {setup}, on the computer: download it from Admin, System page
station.notInstallable: KyberNow Station {version} can’t be installed from a device: {reason}

manifest.otherKey: manifest signed with a key other than KyberNow’s
manifest.badSignature: invalid manifest signature: tampered or damaged version
manifest.versionMismatch: the signed manifest announces version {version} but GitHub publishes {tag}
manifest.channel: version {version} is on the {channel} channel: this computer follows the {followed} channel
manifest.minInstaller: version {version} requires at least {min}: reinstall with {setup}
manifest.requiresSetup: version {version} installs with {setup}: reinstall with it
manifest.noPackage: the manifest of version {version} contains no update package
manifest.sizeMismatch: {name}: {size} bytes instead of {expected}: download damaged or tampered with
manifest.hashMismatch: hash of {name} differs from the signed manifest: download damaged or tampered with

events.takeover: {newcomer} is taking over: asked {previous} to end its session
events.endRequested: Asked {name} to end its session from Admin
events.noSignal: no more signal from the device
events.paired: {name} received its access (pairing with a code)
events.restartWaiting: Server restart pending to {why}: it will happen as soon as the current session ends
events.pairRefused: Access declined for {name} (pairing with a code)
events.stationRestartedAccount: A device on account {account} restarted the Station
events.stationUpdateAccount: A device on account {account} started the update to {version}
events.displayKeepsTurningOn: Windows keeps turning a display of the computer back on: it stays on for the rest of the session
events.displayModeFollowed: The virtual display switched to {mode} (requested: {target}), left as is
events.displayModeRestored: The virtual display switched to {mode}: set back to {target}
events.displayModeGaveUp: The virtual display keeps going back to {mode} (a game forces it): left as is for the rest of the session
events.displaysOffAgain: {count} displays of the computer turned back on during the session: turned off again
events.displayOffAgain: A display of the computer turned back on during the session: turned off again
events.displayOffFailed: A display of the computer turned back on during the session and could not be turned off: {error}
events.displayOffGaveUp: The display that turned back on could not be turned off after three attempts: it stays on for the rest of the session
events.launchedAfterUnlock: {app} opened for {name} once the Windows session was unlocked
events.launchFront: {app} was already open: brought to the front for {name}
events.launchLocked: {app} was not opened for {name}: the Windows session stayed locked for 2 minutes
events.launchClosed: {app} closed at the end of {name}'s session
events.launchKept: {app} stays open: {next} is taking over with the same app
events.launchCleared: No app opened at the start of {name}'s sessions any more
